## Summary

Reconciles the actual landed P31.19 baseline against the Round-10 dependency/design map and ships
the strict, read-only current-state audit — S6 landable unit 1 of 4 (projection = P32.7, writer
protocol = P32.8, doc refresh = P33.8; this PR is deliberately not those).

- **`docs/build/tools/audit_current_state.py`** — stdlib-only strict parser over the manifest chain,
  LEDGER CURRENT STATE + PHASE LOG, DEFERRALS, COVERAGE_MATRIX and ADR file/index/Appendix-F
  supersessions. Emits `{check, severity, file, obligation, evidence, message}` records; severities
  `error` (structural) vs `conflict` (ambiguity needing a *recorded* reconciliation — never silently
  resolved, no last-token-wins). Reports go only to **caller-provided** `--json-out/--md-out` paths
  with SHA-256 input digests (the opposite of the vendored validator's shared `/tmp` report — that
  defect is confirmed landed and routed to P32.8). Forward-dependency detection resolves against
  **physical manifest row order**, so inserted/legacy filenames (P30.2a/b, P21.x pointer rows) can't
  hide behind sequence 0.
- **`tests/unit/test_build_memory_audit.py`** — 20 adversarial fixture tests: malformed/duplicate
  obligation ids, OPEN-first/DONE-later status conflicts, legacy-filename forward deps (the exact
  case a seq-0 mapping misses), coverage/ledger/ADR defect classes, and input-digest equality
  proving the audit never mutates inputs even when diagnostics fire.
- **`reports/p32.1-baseline/RECONCILIATION.md`** + machine output `discrepancies.{json,md}` — the
  baseline inventory: P31.19 tip `08d87c4` (PR #154), every DESIGN ownership row vs landed
  code/tests/recorded hosted+public evidence, demonstrated defects vs hypotheses vs closed seams vs
  still-owed kept *separate*, unresolved delta decisions all named.
- **`EVIDENCE_DOMAINS_AND_SOURCE_FUNNEL.md`** — the 5 named evidence domains
  (fixture/implementation/composed-db/hosted/public, non-substitutable) and 8 named source-funnel
  units (discovered→published, authority per unit) with baseline values labelled by domain+date.
- **DEFERRALS** — append-only annotations: in-cell notes on the 3 engineering rows (verified defect
  locations + scheduled homes) and the 4 parser-flagged status-conflict rows (interpretation owed by
  P32.7's event migration), plus a bottom audit-annotations section. **No row closed, no status
  flip.**
- **DESIGN §P32.1 baseline addendum** — appends the scope reduction: D-P31.5-2 narrows to the common
  eligibility policy + the API `cached_canonical_name` label path + the row's recorded policy choice
  (web already honours the flag, recorded at P31.16).
- **COVERAGE_MATRIX** — SIG-MEM-001 row → MET (715 rows still OK).
